text_en: It was narrated from Anas that: The Prophet (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, and Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, would start their recitation with: "All the praise and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of all that exists.
text_id: Telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Qutaibah bin Sa'id] dia berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abu 'Awanah] dari [Qatadah] dari [Anas] dia berkata; dia berkata: "Nabi Shallallahu'alihiwasallam, Abu Bakar, dan Umar Radliyallahu'anhum memulai bacaannya dengan membaca, 'Alhamdulillah Rabbil 'Alamin."
